steps.description:
(Using any loops) Show that your robot can perform the following together for 5 seconds:

1. Display "00:00:05" on the LCD.
2. Play a beeping sound of 5 beeps.

 

Hint:

1. Repeat # time loop.
2. Ask the robot to wait.
3. The display should disappear when the program ends.

(Using any loops) Show that your robot can perform the following together for 1 second:

1. Display "00:00:05" on the LCD.
2. Play a beeping sound of 5 beeps.

 

Hint:

1. Repeat # time loop.
2. Ask the robot to wait.
3. Calculate the beep seconds

    For example,
    Beeping sound of 5 beeps within 1 seconds
    1 second ÷ 5 Beeps= 0.2 second each beep
    The wait and sound will each be 0.1 second

4. The display should disappear when the program ends.

Hint:

3. The display should disappear when the program ends.
